question: Round 5, measure every earnings variant on the same footing. Round 4 showed the fundamentals data itself flatters results (it lacks delisted names): the has-data universe alone lifted cap98+tight from PF 1.76 to 2.14. So here every variant runs on the has-data universe (min_sue -100 = has data, no condition) and is compared with its has-data twin. Does requiring EPS growth add anything there, with and without the stricter SPY filter? And do the bias-free price-only winners hold with the SPY 3% filter?

variants.name: hd_base
variants.why: has-data universe, live picker (the fair baseline)

variants.name: hd_sue0
variants.why: has-data + EPS at least the year-ago quarter's

variants.name: hd_sue0_cap98_tight_spy3
variants.why: + EPS growth (round 4's best risk profile, now against its twin)

variants.name: p_cap98_tight_spy3
variants.why: bias-free: skip RS 99 + tight + SPY 3%, all names
